RAJESHWAR NINAWE Java FullStack Developer rninawe2@gmail.com

+91-7507573959

Bengaluru

Summary

4.1 Years of experience in design, development and testing of Java and Web applications.

Expertise in Java 8, Spring Boot, Microservices, Hibernate and RESTful APIs.

Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming(OOP) concepts and Design Patterns.

Proficient in Angular (TypeScript), HTML, CSS.

Strong Expertise in MVC architecture, J2EE, SQL, GitHub, Agile(Scrum) and SDLC Processes.

Knowledge of Multi Threading, Data Structures and Performance Optimization.

Strong problem solving skills and ability to quickly adapt to new technologies.

Skills

Languages: Java, SQL, TypeScript.

Frameworks: Spring Boot , Angular using TypeScript.

Databases: MySQL.

Build Tools: Maven , NPM

Version Control GitHub

Ticketing Tool: Jira

Cloud Technology: AWS

Experience

Trinity Mobility Java FullStack Developer

July 2021- August 2025 Tools Used: Java 8, Spring Boot ,MySQL etc.

Utilized Object-Oriented Principles (encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, and abstraction) to design robust and maintainable code.

Leveraged Java 8 features such as lambda expressions, Streams API, and Optional to write cleaner and more efficient code.

Implemented JWT-based authentication and authorization to secure RESTful APIs. – Developed and maintained RESTful APIs using Spring Boot and Spring MVC. – Implemented CRUD operations for various modules, ensuring efficient data handling and performance. – Utilized Spring Data JPA and Hibernate for database interaction and ORM. – Designed and developed microservices for scalable and modular applications. – Implemented inter-service communication using REST and messaging queues (RabbitMQ/Kafka) – Set up API Gateway using Spring Cloud Gateway to route requests and handle cross-cutting concerns – Developed functionality for generating and exporting PDF documents from application data – Wrote unit tests using JUnit and Mockito to ensure code quality and reliability – Achieved high test coverage and maintained a robust CI/CD pipeline – Developed and maintained dynamic, responsive single-page applications using Angular – Developed and maintained dynamic, responsive web applications using Angular, enhancing performance and user experience.

Projects

StayEase Pro

Developed a comprehensive hotel reservation system using Java 8 and Spring Boot, integrating MySQL for robust data management. Implemented microservices architecture with Eureka Server for service registry and discovery and Angular for the FrontEnd part. Utilized Spring Security with JWT for secure user authentication. Created RESTful APIs for efficient booking and management functionalities. Employed JUnit and Mockito for rigorous unit and integration testing. Automated deployments using Jenkins and Docker, ensuring continuous delivery and operational efficiency.

Roles and Responsibility

Designed and developed RESTful APIs using Spring Boot (Microservices architecture) for scalable hotel management services

Built responsive frontend modules using Angular (components, services, routing) to provide an intuitive booking and account management experience.

Implemented JWT-based authentication and Spring Security to secure APIs and enable role-based access control. – Built an admin dashboard for user and role management, ensuring controlled access to system resources. – Integrated Hibernate (ORM) with MySQL for effecient database operations, entity mapping, and caching. – Deployed the application on AWS Cloud, ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance optimization. – Implemented third-party integrations (Email, SMS, Whatsapp) to improve customer communication and booking/payment notifications.

Developed audit logging and error handling routines to maintain traceability and transaction reliability. – Conducted unit testing (JUnit) and integration testing (Postman) to ensure system stability and API performance. – Collaborated with stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver features aligned with business needs.

Education

BTech MIT Academy of Engineering, Pune

Graduated: 2020 CGPA: 7.99 / 10

Declaration

I hereby declare that the above information is true to the best of my knowledge and belief.

RAJESHWAR NINAWE.
